svg.title: SFL · Editable SVG overview
svg.desc: Every icon in this sheet is editable vector geometry. Native-size studies are true pixel dimensions, not enlarged labels.
svg.text: EDITABLE VECTOR SYSTEM / APPROVED FORM, FLEXIBLE COLOR

svg.title: SFL · Primary app icon
svg.desc: Editable layered F-shaped scientific figure library icon. Each component is an independent named layer.

svg.text: Layered F / density curves / three bars

svg.title: SFL · Flat app icon
svg.desc: Flat-color master for convenient manual recoloring.

svg.title: SFL · Open brand mark
svg.desc: Two library rails, a density curve, and a bar module; transparent background.

svg.title: SFL · Dark app icon
svg.desc: Open library-rail mark on a dark background.

svg.title: SFL · Light app icon
svg.desc: Flat artwork on a light surface.

svg.title: SFL · Monochrome brand mark
svg.desc: A single ink with genuinely transparent bar knockouts, not white overpainting.

svg.title: SFL · Reverse brand mark
svg.desc: White artwork for dark surfaces; transparent background and cutouts.

svg.text: Shown at actual SVG pixel dimensions on this 1600 px board.

svg.title: SFL · 64 px
svg.desc: 64 px version; full double-density motif, flat colors.

svg.title: SFL · 32 px
svg.desc: 32 px optical size on its own pixel grid. Three cards, one curve, three bars; secondary density removed.

svg.title: SFL · 24 px
svg.desc: 24 px optical size on its own pixel grid. Three cards, one curve, three bars; secondary density removed.

svg.title: SFL · 16 px
svg.desc: 16 px optical size on its own pixel grid. Two cards, one curve, three micro bars.

svg.text: Cards, curves and bars remain separate editable layers.
Flat masters contain direct fills; gradients are optional.
SFL / SVG KIT v2 · Colors are editable; change palette.json and rebuild.
